The suite now passes: 7 of 7, including `test_exact_payment_settles_invoice`.

**The cause:** `promos.discount_total` rounded the discount once per line. The three lines gave 933 + 3522 + 6111 = 10566 cents. Rounding once on the 1428.00 subtotal gives 10567 cents. That one-cent difference made the total due 1351.26, so the 1351.25 payment came out `UNDERPAID`.

**The fix:** in `src/ledger/promos.py`, `discount_total` now returns `rules.discount_for(invoice.subtotal())`. I also removed the `ZERO` import, which nothing used any more.

I didn't touch `handling_total`. It comes to 2642 cents whether you round per line or once, so it doesn't affect this test.

The `rules.py` change that was uncommitted before this session is still there and I left it alone.

I haven't committed anything.
